names: Cyclamic acid and its sodium and calcium salts, also known as Cyclamate
display_name: E952 (Cyclamic acid and its sodium and calcium salts)

more_info.banned_in:
Banned in: United States.
Approved in the EU.
The US prohibition follows the 1969 cyclamate order.
more_info.overview: E952 covers cyclamic acid and its sodium and calcium salts, which are related high-intensity sweetener preparations. It provides sweetness when added to the food or used in a table-top sweetener preparation. The specified material is supplied as white powder or crystalline material. The specification identifies water solubility as one of its properties.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain other confectionery including breath freshening microsweets; decorations, coatings and fillings, except fruit-based fillings covered by category 4.2.4; fruit nectars as defined by Directive 2001/112/EC and vegetable nectars and similar products; flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products; extra jam and extra jelly as defined by Directive 2001/113/EC; desserts excluding products covered in categories 1, 3 and 4.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
